scope: Static ownership and protocol review; runtime results recorded separately
notes: GroupIndex=0 reverts lookup strategy; index maintenance and duplicate-membership guard remain shared in both comparison arms.
CPU-time phase counters are sums of measured worker elapsed intervals, not OS CPU cycle accounting. Trace all-thread and GT exports are kept separate.
DispatchWaitMs includes scheduling/join overhead and time not spent running this batch on the caller; it is not a pure blocked-wait measurement.
Production record-byte accounting runs only during active capture and is separately timed. Bootstrap bytes occurring before capture are not reconstructed.
Soldier IDs allocate monotonically within authority World; World recreation resets IDs and owns new group/read caches. Integer-wrap forced reuse is not simulated by these fixtures.
